title: Education Access: Quality Learning & Hostel Support
summary: Provide quality education and holistic care to underprivileged children from remote areas through residential facilities.
description:
In partnership with PYDS (Purkhal Youth Development Society), Dehradun, Saksham Trust supports the Navjeevan residential program, which extends learning opportunities to children facing geographic and socio-economic barriers.

The project offers a secure hostel facility, structured academic support, and comprehensive care including wellness programs, life skills development, and emotional well-being support. This integrated model strengthens educational continuity, empowers children to envision brighter futures, and bridges systemic inequalities in access to quality schooling. The initiative reinforces the Right to Education and national goals for inclusive child development.
